problem_restatement.input: The active backend and checkpoint use v53, while the last continuous-improvement digest and default decision ledger describe older profiles.
problem_restatement.required_output: An exact v53-bound, report-only hypothesis ledger and ranked next investigation that cannot mutate execution.
constraints: Preserve the live v53 configuration and process.
Do not infer profitability from a zero-trade prefix.
Do not reopen rejected entry or exit relaxations without new evidence.
Require explicit human approval for every future live strategy, risk, asset, sizing, leverage, execution, or configuration change.
success_criteria: The decision ledger profile and fingerprint exactly match v53.
Only the three configured v53 provider-symbol routes enter the queue.
The deployed HYPE freshness repair is no longer reported as pending.
The next investigation is report-only and source-bound.

known_facts.interpretation: This prefix proves technical observation and accounting continuity only; it provides no v53 expectancy evidence.

root_cause.finding: The v53 cutover occurred after the last improvement digest, no v53 override ledger existed, and no improvement-monitor process was running.
root_cause.falsifier: A newer source-bound v53 digest or a running monitor using an exact v53 override would falsify this finding; neither was present at diagnosis.

opportunity_ranking.downside: Live execution may lose and sparse outcomes may mislead.
opportunity_ranking.why_now: It is the only bidirectional and one-minute v53 route, but exact v53 closed-lifecycle evidence is zero and later short-side evidence remains absent.

opportunity_ranking.downside: The expected cadence is sparse and the route is long-only.
opportunity_ranking.why_now: Development and one later winner are promising but insufficient to establish repeatability.

opportunity_ranking.downside: Pseudo-holdout evidence was negative and a single later winner is not repeatability.
opportunity_ranking.why_now: The exact live route remains unresolved rather than rejected, but its evidence is weaker than the HYPE information opportunity.

highest_value_next_investigation.minimum_diagnostic_evidence: At least one attributable eligible event with an explicit action or withholding outcome; any fill additionally requires reconciled protection and a resolved lifecycle.
highest_value_next_investigation.minimum_directional_update: At least one fully resolved, exact-cost lifecycle per configured side. This is diagnostic evidence, not a promotion threshold.
analysis_required: Fees, funding, spread, slippage, and submission latency
Stop, opposite-signal, soft-hold, and hard-hold behavior

closed_or_deferred_ideas.rule: The exact v52 rejected, deferred, accepted, and superseded decisions remain authoritative unless their recorded reopen condition is met by new evidence.
currently_not_reopened: Previously rejected low-timeframe and cross-asset families

recommendation.Recommendation: Publish and continuously refresh an exact v53 report-only improvement digest; prioritize attributable HYPE long and short lifecycle collection without changing the route.
recommendation.Why now: The live system is healthy, but its research control plane is stale and the new profile has no closed lifecycle evidence.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: Exact v53 configuration and fingerprint, fresh checkpoint, current decision-ledger prefix, v53 poststart acceptance, v53 stress artifact, inherited v52 decision ledger, HYPE alignment replay, and route cadence journal.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: Operational telemetry is current while improvement ranking and proposal state still describe the superseded v52 deployment boundary.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: All regimes observed during the prospective v53 window; route outcomes must be segmented by the actual completed-bar regime evidence.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Do nothing, continue using the stale digest, immediately retune entries, add routes, or repair only the v53 report-only identity layer.
recommendation.Expected upside: Correct research prioritization, immediate anomaly visibility, and source-correct evidence for deciding whether the highest-cadence route retains after-cost edge.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: Sparse-sample overreaction, largest-winner dependence, silent identity drift, stale checkpoints, technical telemetry gaps, and treating report-only markouts as fills.
recommendation.Validation completed: v53 backend/checkpoint identity, flat state, zero-epoch accounting, fresh telemetry, and the absence of a v53 improvement ledger were directly reconciled.
recommendation.Validation still required: Load and hash validation of the v53 override, one successful exact digest publication, continued source freshness, and prospective HYPE lifecycle evidence.
recommendation.Success metrics: Exact identity reconciliation, complete accounting, every eligible event mapped to action or withholding, every fill mapped to protection and close, realistic cost attribution, and no unsupported live proposal.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: Profile or run mismatch, stale checkpoint, incomplete audit, technical fault, missing action/withholding outcome, unresolved protection, or evidence hash drift invalidates the digest and prevents recommendation updates.
recommendation.Confidence level: high on the control-plane defect and investigation ranking; low on v53 profitability because no lifecycle has closed
